_comment: The prebuilt Manifold pin (tools/fetch_manifold.py; AGENTS.md iteration-speed rule 6). `manifold_csg_sys` is the crate version in Cargo.lock whose build script these flags mirror; `tag`/`commit` are upstream's. tools/test_fetch_manifold.py holds `manifold_csg_sys` to Cargo.lock and `tag` + `cmake_flags` to the crate's source; the script itself refuses to build a clone whose HEAD is not `commit`. Changing the pin changes every CI cache key (hashFiles of this file).
